# Japanese Stroke Assets

This directory contains the local stroke-order assets used by TOKU-UP.

- Kanji paths come from KanjiVG and are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
- Hiragana and katakana paths come from AnimCJK and are distributed under LGPL.
- The Jouyou inventory metadata is derived from `davidluzgouveia/kanji-data` under the MIT License. Curriculum scope still controls which characters users see.
- `kanji-recognizer` is used at runtime under the MIT License.

The complete license texts are stored in the `licenses` directory.
